bootstrapContract: README and this compact manifest are checked against index/anchor bytes but excluded from reconstructed tables to avoid recursive table-hash cycles. All verification code and substantive inputs are ordinary SHA-bound currentBindings.

historicalGit.method: Read local bundle only, verify its exact SHA and prerequisites, import to temporary bare object store. No old branch/history is required in the delivery clone.

externalArchives.role: exact late accepted records captured before slimming

archiveRetrieval.memberKey: Use the former repository-relative path as exact member name in the hash-bound external archive index. tar -xOf ARCHIVE MEMBER retrieves original bytes; compare SHA-256 with index before use.
archiveRetrieval.historicalReproduction: Historical writer helpers and superseded full tables live only in the complete archive; their required former Git objects are supplied by the independently hash-checked local bundle. Current production uses the retained immutable guards and needs no old Git objects.
archiveRetrieval.fullTables: The verifier re-reads actual repository/external/archive bytes, resolves raw and native JSON-value bindings, independently recomputes every full table, and compares exact table bytes to the external table-index. No full table is stored in this repository.
